name: Agile Gadgets for Jira
tagline: Twenty dashboard gadgets — burndown, velocity, cumulative flow, cycle time, time in status, aging WIP, throughput, pivots, KPI gauges, a team board and a TV wallboard — rebuilt from issue history. Free for 10 users, then US$0.60 per user.
highlights: Sprint, epic and release burndown, velocity, sprint health, cumulative flow, cycle and lead time, time in status, aging WIP, throughput, pivot tables, KPI gauges, work breakdown, a team board, worklog reports, a countdown and a world clock — with no Advanced edition to buy.

Charts replay status, sprint and fix-version changes from the changelog: scope-change markers name the issues, the commitment baseline is the sprint's start instant, throughput counts the day work crossed into done, and days are bucketed in the viewer's own timezone.

Velocity reconciles committed, added and removed; CFD bands never go negative; each issue's time-in-status rows sum to its own age; a work breakdown rolls up at every level. Every gadget exports its series as CSV and its picture as PNG.
